title: Please
label: ch:hi-please
canDo: I can say please in Hindi, both with कृपया and with the polite verb ending everyday speech actually prefers.

payoff.summary: Say कृपया with its vocalic ऋ, unpack it as 'of your compassion', then switch to the everyday बैठिए, 'please sit'.
payoff.note: Left at 2/5, below the floor, because no honest repair exists without reordering lessons. HI-C08-kripaya (sequence 510) is the chapter's first lesson by sequence, but its last on the curriculum path (HI-PATH-012). The chapter's three one-character segments, HI-S144-vowel-sign-vocalic-r, HI-S03-letter-a and HI-S112-vowel-sign-e (sequence 511-516), all sit in the early script segment HI-PATH-100. So each is later than कृपया by sequence and earlier by path. A prerequisite must be earlier on both, so कृपया cannot assess them, and none of them can take कृपया's atoms as a payoff (HI-S144, which writes कृ out of कृपया, was tried and fails curriculum-prerequisite-order). The repair needs the sequence and the path to agree for this chapter.
